subject.title: feat(chat-ui): inline diffs for edit and write tool rows

question: Should shared Apple chat show exact diffstats for write/create rows only when the tool result supplies authoritative creation or before/after evidence?
rationale: The gateway write result may be successful for either a new file or an overwrite, so the UI cannot derive an honest deletion count from arguments alone; choosing between preview-only and a broader result-contract change is product/API direction.

options.title: Authoritative stats only
options.body: Render exact `+N −M` only from structured tool-result diff data or an explicit created-file outcome, and otherwise show a bounded write preview without a stat.

options.title: Extend the result contract
options.body: Add authoritative write outcome/diff metadata before presenting exact stats, with compatible gateway and Apple-client coverage.

options.title: Accept inferred additions
options.body: Keep the current `+N −0` display while accepting that overwrite rows can be misleading.

recommendation.title: Authoritative stats only
recommendation.body: Render exact `+N −M` only from structured tool-result diff data or an explicit created-file outcome, and otherwise show a bounded write preview without a stat.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant merged shared-chat surface and its current follow-up history are both associated with this contributor.
